---
applyTo: "**/*.md,**/docs/**,**/README*"
---

# Documentation Instructions

- Write in clear, concise English. Use active voice.
- Structure with proper headings (H1 for title, H2 for sections, H3 for subsections).
- Include code examples with proper language tags in fenced code blocks.
- Use relative links for files within the repository (e.g., `docs/CONTRIBUTING.md`).
- Add alt text to images.
- Keep paragraphs short — aim for 2-3 sentences each.
- Include a table of contents for documents longer than 3 sections.
